name: One Click SEO Optimizer
author: Loopus

sections.description:
SEO That Actually Helps You Finish The Work

Most SEO plugins stop at warnings. One Click SEO Optimizer is built to help you move from analysis to action faster.

Use AI to generate optimized metadata, review content quality, monitor technical SEO issues, and manage your site from a single WordPress dashboard.

What Makes One Click SEO Different

  • One-click optimization for posts, pages, and supported custom post types
  • SEO Health Score dashboard with quick wins and recent activity
  • Built-in technical SEO tools: sitemap, schema, 404 monitoring, redirects, and audits
  • Editor integrations for Elementor, Gutenberg, and Classic Editor
  • Guided onboarding with site presets for common business types
  • Multilingual and WooCommerce support for more advanced sites

Free Features

Dashboard And Optimization

  • SEO Health Score from 0 to 100
  • Optimization coverage and configuration tracking
  • Quick wins to show the next highest-value fixes
  • Recent optimization activity feed
  • One-click AI generation for:
  • SEO title
  • Meta description
  • H1 suggestion
  • Page objective and target audience
  • Content suggestions
  • Internal linking suggestions
  • Readability and content scoring

AI Settings And Workflow

  • OpenAI model selection:
  • gpt-5.2
  • gpt-5-mini
  • gpt-5-nano
  • SEO content language setting with auto-detection or manual override
  • Support for 17+ common languages plus installed WordPress languages
  • Guided onboarding wizard
  • Site presets for:
  • Blog / Publisher
  • E-commerce
  • Local Business
  • Portfolio / Agency
  • Corporate / Enterprise
  • Custom

Technical SEO

  • XML sitemap generation
  • Sitemap ping for Google and Bing
  • 14 schema types with automatic detection:
  • Article
  • BlogPosting
  • NewsArticle
  • WebPage
  • Product
  • LocalBusiness
  • Organization
  • Person
  • FAQPage
  • HowTo
  • Event
  • Recipe
  • Review
  • BreadcrumbList
  • Open Graph and Twitter Card fields
  • Built-in cache layer for dashboard and SEO data

Editor Support

  • Elementor SEO panel
  • Gutenberg-compatible analysis and scoring
  • Classic Editor meta box

Pro Features

Technical Audit

  • Full SEO audit with 47+ checks across 7 categories:
  • Meta tags
  • Images
  • Links
  • Content
  • Indexation
  • Performance
  • Security
  • Selective audit for one, multiple, or all pages
  • Incremental re-audit for selected pages without wiping unrelated results
  • Scope filtering to focus on the last audited pages
  • Batch processing for larger sites
  • Export audit results to CSV

Redirections And 404 Monitoring

  • Automatic 404 logging
  • Redirections manager for 301, 302, and 307 redirects
  • Redirect suggestions from detected 404 URLs
  • Import and export redirects via CSV
  • One-click creation of redirects from the 404 monitor

Google Search Console Analytics

  • OAuth connection to Google Search Console
  • KPIs for clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position
  • Top pages and top queries reports
  • Period comparison for 7 days, 28 days, and 3 months
  • Cached analytics for faster loading

WooCommerce And Multilingual

  • WooCommerce product SEO support
  • Product schema and product Open Graph metadata
  • Product brand, GTIN, and MPN fields
  • Bulk product optimization
  • WPML support
  • Polylang support
  • Hreflang tags and multilingual sitemap support
  • Per-page language detection for multilingual AI generation

Bulk Optimization

  • Bulk SEO optimization from the posts list screen
  • Progress modal with live feedback and cancellation support

External Services

This plugin can connect to the following external services:

OpenAI API

  • Purpose: generate AI-powered SEO recommendations and metadata
  • Data sent: page title, content, excerpts, site context, and selected SEO fields
  • Trigger: only when you request optimization or analysis
  • Provider: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/ and https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

Google Search Console API

  • Purpose: fetch search performance analytics and property data
  • Data sent: OAuth credentials flow and Search Console query requests
  • Trigger: only when a Pro user connects Google Search Console
  • Provider: https://policies.google.com/terms and https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google And Bing Sitemap Notification Endpoints

  • Purpose: notify search engines when the sitemap is generated or refreshed
  • Data sent: sitemap URL
  • Trigger: when sitemap notifications are enabled by the plugin workflow

Privacy Policy

One Click SEO Optimizer may process the following data when features are used:

  • Page content, titles, excerpts, and SEO fields for AI analysis
  • Sitemap URLs for search engine notifications
  • Search Console tokens and analytics responses when connected by the site owner

The plugin does not send personal data to external services unless it is part of the content you choose to analyze. All remote requests use HTTPS.

Support

  • Website: https://oneclickseo.loopus.tech/
  • Documentation: product guides and setup help
  • Support: WordPress support forum
  • Pro: priority support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen, or place the plugin folder in /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open OneClick SEO in the WordPress admin area.
  4. Enter your OpenAI API key.
  5. Choose your model, language, and content types.
  6. Run the onboarding wizard and start optimizing your content.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Yes. The plugin uses your own OpenAI API key for AI-powered optimization and analysis.

Which editors are supported?

The plugin supports Elementor, Gutenberg, and Classic Editor workflows.

What does the SEO Health Score measure?

The score is based on four main factors:

  • Optimization coverage
  • Technical health
  • 404 errors
  • Configuration status

What can the AI generate?

Depending on the workflow, the plugin can generate or suggest:

  • SEO title
  • Meta description
  • H1
  • Keywords
  • Page objective
  • Target audience
  • Content suggestions
  • Internal linking suggestions
  • Structured data recommendations

Does the plugin support multilingual sites?

Yes. Pro includes WPML and Polylang support, hreflang handling, multilingual sitemap support, and per-page language detection for AI generation.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes. Pro includes WooCommerce-focused SEO features such as product schema, product metadata support, and bulk product optimization.

Can I audit only a few pages instead of the whole site?

Yes. Pro includes selective audit, so you can audit one page, multiple pages, or the full site.

What does the technical audit check?

The audit covers meta tags, images, links, content quality, indexation, performance, and security signals.

What PHP version is required?

PHP 7.4 or higher.

Where can I get help?

Visit https://oneclickseo.loopus.tech/ or use the WordPress support area. Pro users receive priority support.
